description: Minimal read foundation, deferred mount/write contracts and bounded storage reuse
decisions: Core crates are independent of mount libraries.
Write batches describe ordering and durability, not universal crash atomicity.
Real fixture and OS qualification remain required beyond the initial contract seed.
